comment: SoundMusicSys music driver: decrypted + LZSS-decompressed 'MDRV' 11 (GetDriverCodeResource). Offsets are from the start of the decompressed code (Ghidra program mdrv11.bin, base 0). Entry points: the C-convention entry drv(selector, arg) at 0, and the routines the driver hands to the Toolbox (Sound Manager doubleBack, VBL task through a stub, PAS16 card completion and interrupt).
